topic: Report export functionality and data structure
summary_markdown:
The team discussed improvements to the report generation process, specifically regarding exporting metrics. The existing endpoint `/api/dashboard/traffic/report` was confirmed to be updated with new metrics.

**Export Functionality:** It was decided that while maintaining the current cloud-icon export mechanism (which is familiar to long-term users), a standard rectangular 'EXPORT' button should also be added next to report options for consistency across all export locations. The existing cloud icon must remain in charts where data is client-side rendered.

**Data Metrics:** Discussion covered discrepancies in reported impressions, noting that two types of impression data exist (from Vlad and Marina). A follow-up was required from a third party to determine the feasibility of consolidating these into a single type. For now, two separate columns are expected to remain in the report.
decisions: A standard 'EXPORT' button will be added alongside the existing cloud icon export mechanism for consistency.
The current cloud icon export functionality must be retained on client-side rendered charts.
action_items: Someone needs to confirm the feasibility of consolidating two types of impression data into one type.
